description: Realistic adopter workflow corpus: pinned synthetic Rust and Node fixture repositories with real build/test configuration. Six behavior classes from issue #458. Default budgets keep the 30s/120s CI caps; the experimental-pilot profile is explicit opt-in only.

experimental-pilot.recorded_from: manual pilot cold builds on 2026-11-21: tiny rust crate ~4s cold, incremental ~1s; node suite ~0.2s

protocol.counterbalancing: alternating per-case pair order (control first on even case index)
protocol.decision_rule: go only if the treatment advantage's 95% confidence interval lies entirely above max(tolerance, minimum_effect); no-go if the interval favors control (upper bound below zero); otherwise inconclusive
protocol.design: paired comparison; arms differ by exactly one declared feature
exclusions: cases where the adapter declares unsupported before interacting

sample_size.note: descriptive paired sample; no causal claim below n=30

protocol.stopping_rule: stop at predeclared repeats; no outcome peeking; resolve ambiguity with the predeclared tolerance
